description: Is the pipeline keeping up? Throughput, Flink lag, data freshness, platform health and alerts.

options.content:
### Operations
Stream throughput and lag (Prometheus), freshness of each stage (TimescaleDB), JVM memory and alert states.  
**[Federated learning & privacy](/d/flead-fl-lab)** · **[Anomalies](/d/flead-anomaly)** · **[Devices](/d/flead-device)** · **[Operations](/d/flead-ops)** · [Live monitor ↗](http://localhost:5001) · [Device viewer ↗](http://localhost:8082)

panels.title: Readings / s
panels.description: Collector throughput (15-second snapshots). The producer sends 150 per second.

targets.rawSql: SELECT GREATEST(0, (a.metric_value - b.metric_value) * 1 / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM a.timestamp - b.timestamp), 0)) AS value FROM (SELECT metric_value, timestamp FROM dashboard_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'total_iot_count' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) a CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT metric_value, timestamp FROM dashboard_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'total_iot_count' AND timestamp <= a.timestamp - INTERVAL '60 seconds' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) b

panels.title: Flink reads / s
panels.description: Readings the Flink job pulls from Kafka per second; under backpressure this is its processing rate.

panels.title: Flink lag
panels.description: Readings waiting in Kafka for Flink. Above 9,000 (one minute of stream) for 10 minutes, FlinkFallingBehind fires.

panels.title: Backpressure
panels.description: Whether a Flink task is waiting on a slower downstream task.

panels.title: Anomaly age
panels.description: Age of the newest flagged reading (reading time). Grows with Flink lag.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - MAX(ts)) AS value FROM anomalies WHERE ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Prometheus alert rules currently firing.

panels.title: Stored vs processed per second
panels.description: If Flink reads less than the collector stores, the lag grows.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', timestamp) AS t, MAX(metric_value) AS v FROM dashboard_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'total_iot_count' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1) SELECT t AS time, GREATEST(0, (v - LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY t)) * 1 / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t - LAG(t) OVER (ORDER BY t)), 0)) AS "Stored by collector" FROM s ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Flink lag
panels.description: Kafka consumer lag of the Flink job; the shaded area is above the alert threshold.

panels.title: Reading age
panels.description: Age of the newest stored reading.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - MAX(ts)) AS value FROM iot_data WHERE ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'

panels.title: Local model age
panels.description: Age of the newest local model the aggregator received.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - MAX(created_at)) AS value FROM local_models WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'

panels.title: Round age
panels.description: Rounds run every 60 s once 200 devices have reported.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - MAX(created_at)) AS value FROM federated_models

panels.title: Evaluation age
panels.description: Spark checks for a new global version every 120 s.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - MAX(evaluation_timestamp)) AS value FROM model_evaluations WHERE evaluation_timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day' AND device_id = 'ALL'

panels.title: Z-score age
panels.description: Spark writes 30-second windows every 30 s after a one-minute watermark.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - MAX(timestamp)) AS value FROM stream_analysis_results WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'

panels.title: Active devices
panels.description: Devices with a reading stored in the last 5 minutes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT metric_value AS value FROM dashboard_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'active_devices_5m' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Local models and anomalies per minute
panels.description: From the 15-second KPI snapshots (insert time).

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', timestamp) AS t, MAX(metric_value) AS v FROM dashboard_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'total_local_models_count' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1) SELECT t AS time, GREATEST(0, (v - LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY t)) * 60 / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t - LAG(t) OVER (ORDER BY t)), 0)) AS "Local models" FROM s ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', timestamp) AS t, MAX(metric_value) AS v FROM dashboard_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'total_anomalies_count' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1) SELECT t AS time, GREATEST(0, (v - LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY t)) * 60 / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t - LAG(t) OVER (ORDER BY t)), 0)) AS "Anomalies stored" FROM s ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Devices per federated round
panels.description: Rounds need at least 200 devices.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, num_devices AS "Devices" FROM federated_models WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Flink job uptime
panels.description: Time since the Flink training job (re)started.

panels.title: Flink restarts
panels.description: Restarts of the Flink job since submission.

panels.title: Spark workers
panels.description: Workers registered with the Spark master.

panels.title: Scrape targets up
panels.description: Endpoints Prometheus scraped successfully (5 expected).

panels.title: DB errors
panels.description: Failed TimescaleDB connections from the monitor since it started.

panels.title: KPI snapshot age
panels.description: Age of the newest fleet KPI snapshot (dashboard-metrics-updater, every 15 s).

panels.title: JVM heap used
panels.description: The FlinkTaskManagerHeapHigh alert fires above 90%.

panels.title: Alert rules pending or firing
panels.description: Rules are defined in prometheus/alerts.yml.

defaults.noValue: No alert rules are pending or firing

panels.title: Latest readings
panels.description: Readings stored in the last 5 minutes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "Time", device_id AS "Device", ROUND(value::numeric, 3) AS "tcp.ack", CASE label WHEN 1 THEN 'attack' ELSE 'benign' END AS "Label" FROM iot_data WHERE ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Current KPI snapshot
panels.description: Latest fleet KPIs from dashboard-metrics-updater and Spark.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_name) CASE metric_name WHEN 'total_iot_count' THEN 'Readings stored' WHEN 'total_anomalies_count' THEN 'Anomalies stored' WHEN 'total_local_models_count' THEN 'Local models stored' WHEN 'total_federated_models_count' THEN 'Global versions' WHEN 'devices_with_models' THEN 'Devices with models' WHEN 'active_devices_5m' THEN 'Active devices (5 min)' WHEN 'stale_devices_count' THEN 'Stale devices' WHEN 'anomaly_rate_1h' THEN 'Readings flagged (1 h)' WHEN 'anomaly_attack_share_1h' THEN 'RRCF precision (1 h)' WHEN 'global_model_heldout_accuracy' THEN 'Held-out accuracy' WHEN 'global_model_heldout_f1' THEN 'Held-out F1' WHEN 'spark_batch_device_day_rows' THEN 'Daily statistics rows' ELSE metric_name END AS "Metric", CASE WHEN metric_name LIKE '%f1' THEN to_char(metric_value, 'FM0.000') WHEN metric_unit = 'ratio' THEN to_char(metric_value * 100, 'FM990.0') || ' %' ELSE to_char(metric_value, 'FM999,999,990') END AS "Value", timestamp AS "Updated" FROM dashboard_metrics WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' ORDER BY metric_name, timestamp DESC

title: FLEAD - Operations
